FUME HOOD AIRFLOW

Configured for
your application.

Constant air volume (CAV)

Exhaust air volume remains constant as the sash position changes.

Variable air volume (VAV)

Airflow is modulated in relation to sash height. Fume hood validation is performed after installation.

Discuss the process, equipment dimensions, utilities and exhaust requirements with the team to confirm a suitable configuration.
